data.description: 【凯尔希 · 茶叙】办公室内弥漫着略带苦涩的红茶香气，凯尔希端起精致的白瓷茶杯轻抿一口，眉眼在热茶升腾的薄雾中微垂——「无糖的浓红茶有助于维持高强度的神经运转。如果你习惯了加奶加糖……旁边有阿米娅为你准备的方糖盒。」
data.promptProse: Kal'tsit lifts black tea in her private office corner, eyes lowered as a rare gentle sigh eases the commander's composure. Oatmeal chunky-knit turtleneck and deep-emerald lounge trousers retain the home outfit. The medium close-up includes cup and nearby desk edge, with the quiet office extending behind her shoulder. Soft window light reveals the knit texture and tea rim, leaving delicate cup shadows and darker recesses around the sheltered corner.
data.title: 凯尔希 · 茶叙
